## The AI/digital transformation angle (this is the one Ryan Suchala would actually be talking about)

The **Digital Initiative - Mortgage / Acct Opening** is the flagship engagement and the one most relevant to a "digital transformation" conversation. Timeline history shows:
- Originated from a Discovery around **"Online Account Opening"** and a **"digital mortgage initiative."**
- The stated business driver, in Improving's own account manager's words to the client: *"your customer-facing experience and the desire to move toward a single portal with a unified login."*
- Key stakeholders involved: Jack Eastman and Vinay Menon (First United Bank), and on Improving's side Vicki Kelly, Kevin Baker, David Belcher, Venkat Palivela, David Schwartz, and now Diana Stevens.
- Stage moved from 10% to 50% probability as of a 3/19/2026 note from Diana Stevens — deal is progressing, not stalled.
- No explicit mention of "AI" or "machine learning" in the CRM notes I reviewed — this reads as a **digital/customer-experience modernization** initiative (unified portal, online account opening, digital mortgage) rather than a named AI project. If Ryan Suchala talks about AI on the podcast, it's likely either aspirational/future-state framing on top of this initiative, or something outside what's tracked in Dynamics.

The **SQL (On-prem) to Azure Migration** opportunity is the closest thing to a "data" initiative — moving off-prem SQL workloads to Azure, which is a natural precursor/enabler for any future AI or analytics work, but it's early-stage (25% Qualified) and small ($10,000, likely just a discovery/assessment phase).

## What's missing
- No formal account plan, strategic initiative document, or AI-specific scope-of-work was found attached to the account in Dynamics — only opportunity records and email/timeline notes.
- No Ryan Suchala contact record in CRM at all. If he's your podcast guest and a stakeholder at First United Bank, he isn't currently logged as a contact on this account — worth flagging to Diana Stevens or checking spelling/title before the episode.

## Recommendation for podcast prep
Frame the episode around the **digital/customer-experience modernization** work (unified portal, digital account opening/mortgage) since that's the real, funded, in-flight engagement — rather than assuming a dedicated "AI project" exists in the pipeline. If Ryan Suchala raises AI specifically, it's fair to ask how it connects to or extends this initiative, since Improving doesn't have a named AI opportunity logged against First United Bank today.
